name: runtime-fit-before-browser
argv: --command=set -eu; sudo docker inspect --format '{"Name":{{json .Name}},"Id":{{json .Id}},"Image":{{json .Image}},"ConfigImage":{{json .Config.Image}},"User":{{json .Config.User}},"Status":{{json .State.Status}},"Pid":{{.State.Pid}},"OOMKilled":{{.State.OOMKilled}},"ReadonlyRootfs":{{.HostConfig.ReadonlyRootfs}},"CapAdd":{{json .HostConfig.CapAdd}},"CapDrop":{{json .HostConfig.CapDrop}},"SecurityOpt":{{json .HostConfig.SecurityOpt}},"Memory":{{.HostConfig.Memory}},"PidsLimit":{{.HostConfig.PidsLimit}},"Ports":{{json .NetworkSettings.Ports}},"Mounts":{{json .Mounts}}}' remission-simulation-app-1 remission-simulation-generator-1 remission-simulation-proxy-1; sudo docker network inspect --format '{"Name":{{json .Name}},"Internal":{{.Internal}},"Driver":{{json .Driver}}}' remission-simulation_private remission-simulation_edge; for container in remission-simulation-app-1 remission-simulation-generator-1 remission-simulation-proxy-1; do printf "metrics %s\n" "$container"; sudo docker exec "$container" sh -c "cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events"; done; free -b; df -B1 / /srv/remission; sudo docker stats --no-stream --format "{{.Name}} {{.MemUsage}} {{.CPUPerc}} {{.PIDs}}"; sudo journalctl -k --since "2026-10-23 04:24:25 UTC" --grep "Out of memory|Killed process|oom-kill" --no-pager
